training_eligible_reason: Diagnostic/decision artifact for the leave-HLA-out H4 gate. Not model training data.
question: Is A375 B2M-KO's 88% retained immunopeptidome (vs HAP1 B2M-KO's 3%) a technical artifact or genuine B2M-independent biology?
deposit: PXD065279 (MHC1-TIP: scalable multimodal immunopeptidome profiling of low-input samples)
data_file: MB_30_A375_WT_and_B2M-KO_MHC1-TIP_fragpipe_combined_peptide.tsv (FragPipe combined_peptide, per-condition WT vs B2M_KO spectral counts + intensities + match types)
verdict_one_line: The 88% is a MILD-ACID-ELUTION (MHC1-TIP) method artifact, NOT genuine biology and NOT a leaky KO. B2M-KO is CLEAN (zero residual B2M). The true HLA-I LIGAND signal collapsed to ~12% retained — fully consistent with H4 and with HAP1's collapse. The apparent 88% is a large B2M-independent intracellular/non-ligand peptide BACKGROUND that mild acid elution co-releases and that persists when surface HLA-I is gone.
recommendation_for_gate: EXCLUDE the A375 B2M-KO point AS SCORED (naive total-peptide retention). It does NOT contradict H4; it is an apples-to-oranges enrichment method (MAE surface strip, not W6/32 pan-HLA-I IP) whose readout is dominated by non-HLA background. If re-scored on GENUINE HLA-I ligands only, A375 B2M-KO retention = 0.119 (~12%), which AGREES with HAP1 (0.03) and SUPPORTS H4. The load-bearing anti-correlation in LEAVE_HLA_OUT_RESULT (held-out HAP1 transfer rho -0.92) was driven by this mis-measured point.

check1_KO_completeness.interpretation: B2M protein peptides are present in WT and DISAPPEAR entirely in the KO (0 spectral counts, 0 intensity, unmatched). This rules out the leaky/incomplete-KO hypothesis: the KO genuinely eliminated B2M. Therefore the 88% retention CANNOT be explained by residual B2M keeping surface HLA-I assembled.

check2_are_retained_peptides_genuine_HLA.conclusion: NO — the retained repertoire is dominated by NON-HLA-I background; HLA-I ligand QUALITY collapses on KO.

length_distribution.interpretation: WT peaks at 9mers (30% 9mer, median 9) = canonical HLA-I. In the KO the 9mer fraction HALVES (30%->16%), the peak and median shift to 10, 8-11mer fraction drops. The KO length profile degrades away from the HLA-I signature toward a broader/longer (intracellular/tryptic) profile.

binding_motif_anchor_match.method: exact-sequence overlap of 8-11mers with mono-allelic ligands of A375's OWN HLA-I alleles (A*01:01, A*02:01, B*44:03, B*57:01, C*06:02, C*16:01) from the 197-allele mono-allelic anchor (135,859 A375-allele ligands).
binding_motif_anchor_match.interpretation: 48.8% of WT 8-11mers are EXACT known ligands of A375's alleles (very high for exact-match-only vs a finite panel -> WT is a bona fide A375 HLA-I immunopeptidome). In the KO this crashes to 12.0% (4-fold). The peptides that remain are largely NOT HLA-I binders.

a0201_anchor_heuristic.interpretation: A*02:01 anchor enrichment (pos2 hydrophobic) drops 49%->35% on KO -> loss of A2-restricted ligands.

cterm_residue.interpretation: WT C-termini dominated by Y/L/F (HLA-A1/A2/B57/B44 anchors), only 12% K/R. KO loses the Y-anchor peak (A*01:01/B-anchor gone) and enriches K/R (tryptic) and acidic D/S (non-anchor) -> shift toward non-HLA background.

check3_prep_metadata.conclusion: ROOT CAUSE. Enrichment is MILD ACID ELUTION (MHC1-TIP), NOT W6/32 pan-HLA-I immunoprecipitation.
check3_prep_metadata.enrichment_method: Mild acid elution (MAE): 131 mM citric acid / 66 mM Na2HPO4 / 150 mM NaCl / 25 mM iodoacetamide, pH 3.3, in suspension or on-plate; 10 kDa ultrafilter + C18 StageTip cleanup.
check3_prep_metadata.immunoprecipitation: NONE. No W6/32, no pan-HLA-I antibody IP for this A375 WT/B2M-KO pair (FragPipe DDA).
check3_prep_metadata.surface_vs_whole_cell: Surface acid-strip in principle, but PRIDE metadata explicitly notes 'Identification of intracellular peptides post-mild acid elution' and documents an MHC1-TIP-vs-immunoprecipitation comparison. MAE co-releases a substantial B2M-INDEPENDENT intracellular/membrane peptide background that antibody-IP would exclude.
check3_prep_metadata.why_it_matters: HAP1 B2M-KO (PXD056426, the H4 PASS set) used antibody-based pan-HLA-I capture -> its readout is ~pure surface HLA-I ligand, so losing HLA-I collapses it to 3%. A375 here used MAE -> its readout is surface-ligand PLUS a large non-HLA background that does NOT depend on B2M. Comparing MAE total-peptide retention to IP total-peptide retention is method-confounded; they measure different things.

check4_recompute_88pct_robustness.conclusion: The 88% is real AS A TOTAL-PEPTIDE number but MEASURES THE WRONG THING. Stratified by ligand identity it inverts.

naive_total_peptide_measures.note: Prior agent's ~0.88 reproduced. Robust across count/spectral-sum (intensity a bit lower). BUT this pools ligands + background.

stratified_measures_the_discriminator.interpretation: When restricted to peptides that are actually HLA-I ligands of A375's alleles, retention is 11.9% -> ~88% of TRUE HLA-I ligands are LOST on B2M-KO, matching HAP1 (3%) and H4's prediction. The non-HLA background (67.6% retained) is what inflates the naive total to 88%. The prior 'robust 88%' claim is robust only for the wrong (total-peptide) measure; it is NOT robust to controlling for HLA-I ligand identity, where the sign flips from 'retained' to 'collapsed'.

comparison_table.reconciliation: On matched (HLA-I-ligand) readout, A375 (0.119) and HAP1 (0.028) AGREE: B2M-KO collapses HLA-I presentation. The discordance was entirely an enrichment-method + measurement-definition artifact.

impact_on_LEAVE_HLA_OUT_gate.prior_gate_verdict: FAIL / CONTRADICTED; held-out HAP1 transfer rho = -0.92; A375 B2M-KO cited as the load-bearing hard-essential replicate that failed to collapse.
impact_on_LEAVE_HLA_OUT_gate.corrected: A375 B2M-KO does NOT contradict H4. Re-scored on HLA-I ligands it collapses (~12% retained), CONSISTENT with H4. The gate FAIL was driven by (a) this mis-measured artifact point and (b) genuine under-powering on hard-essential KOs (THP-1/HeLa contribute only trimmer/editor KOs). Removing the artifact removes the ACTIVE CONTRADICTION but does NOT by itself PASS the gate: H4 cross-HLA generalization is still UNPROVEN (only HAP1 + this one re-scored A375 point carry hard-essential collapse; still <3 independent hard-essential backgrounds). Reclassify from 'CONTRADICTED' to 'UNPROVEN / under-powered'.
impact_on_LEAVE_HLA_OUT_gate.action: In the gate, either (1) exclude MAE/MHC1-TIP deposits from the total-peptide retention comparison entirely (method-incompatible with IP deposits), or (2) re-score ALL deposits on genuine-HLA-ligand retention (anchor-matched 8-11mers) so MAE and IP are comparable. Do NOT compare MAE total-peptide retention against IP total-peptide retention.

limitations: Genuine-ligand set defined by EXACT-match to a finite mono-allelic anchor (135,859 A375-allele ligands) -> a conservative LOWER bound on ligand count (true binders not in the anchor are miscounted as background, which if anything UNDERSTATES ligand retention symmetrically in WT and KO; the 4-fold quality drop and 12% ligand retention are robust to this).

No NetMHCpan/MHCflurry binding prediction was run (not installed); used exact anchor-overlap + anchor-residue heuristics instead. A predicted-affinity re-score would refine but is very unlikely to overturn a 4-fold anchor-hit drop + halved 9mer fraction.
Single WT vs single B2M-KO condition columns in the FragPipe combined_peptide table (no per-replicate breakdown in this table); spectral-count and intensity cross-checks mitigate.
MAE 'intracellular peptide' background is documented by the depositors themselves in the PRIDE metadata (MHC1-TIP-vs-IP comparison), corroborating the artifact interpretation.
